errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line (TACRED) increases to its final point. The figure shows that the line decreases from its peak at K=32 (approx. 30.5%) to K=64 (approx. 29.5%).

The description incorrectly characterizes the trend of the blue line (TACRED) as a 'steady upward trend'. The line increases from K=8 to K=32, but then decreases from K=32 to K=64. The trend is not steady.

This description of the TACRED (blue) line is an over-simplification that misrepresents the trend. The line does not simply rise to its final value; it rises to a peak of about 30.5% at K=32 and then declines to 29.5% at K=64. The description for the TACRED-Revisit line correctly identifies a similar 'peak then decline' pattern, showing that this level of detail is possible and expected.

The description states that the TACRED (blue) line starts at approximately 23%. However, the plot shows this line starting visibly lower than the TACRED-Revisit line (which is correctly at ~23%). The starting value for TACRED is closer to 22.5%. Stating both lines start at ~23% incorrectly implies they start at the same point.

The description states that the blue line (TACRED) reaches a value of about 29% at K=32. However, the chart shows the value at K=32 is the peak for this line, at approximately 30.5%. The value at K=64 is 29%.

The description states that the green line has triangle markers. According to the legend, the green line (Re-TACRED) has diamond-shaped markers, while the orange line (TACRED-Revisit) has triangle markers.
